lines.t: Thus says the Lord to his servant whom he loves, you seek me, and this is very good, yet if you wish to please me, then you must first become my disciple.
A devoted servant who walks in my ways, my son, I have not forsaken you. If you ask of me forgiveness, I shall surely forgive you.
Even for all you have done, yet to continue in those same sins
For which you have sought forgiveness, is most unpleasant in my sight
For by doing so, you have made my forgiveness of no effect
For that which requires forgiveness is the very same from which you must depart
Lest your repentance become unrepentance, crucifying me again and again in your heart
For repentance is more than asking
It must come from a deep desire to be set free
And my love followed by sincere unyielding
The commitment to make your love perfect
The shedding of the skin of this world
The crucifying of your old man
The putting on of the new man who is
Renewed in the knowledge of the Holy One
Conforming to the image of him who created him
